data.one_liner: Library for handling and parsing the contents of GS1 barcodes.
data.what_it_does: The gs1_barcode_parser package parses GS1 barcode strings, such as code-128 with FNC1, extracting application identifiers and their corresponding data values like GTIN, expiry dates, and batch numbers. It supports custom AI definitions and a wide range of standard GS1 Application Identifiers.
use_when: You need to parse GS1 barcode data and extract application identifiers in Dart or Flutter.
You are processing supply chain or retail barcodes that use GS1 standards.
avoid_when: You need a package that performs actual camera-based barcode scanning (this only parses the resulting string data).
strengths: Supports a comprehensive and growing list of GS1 Application Identifiers (AIs).
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Does not include camera scanning capabilities out-of-the-box.
Documentation outside of the basic README example is limited.
